gaps.sentence: The company needs to ___ (MODERN) its factories.
You will need written ___ (PERMIT) to enter the site.
gaps.explanation: 'Written permission' — the noun you can be given in writing.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (OWN) of the car park charges by the hour.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — the person who owns it; 'ownership' is the state.

gaps.sentence: The model predicts the weather with remarkable ___ (ACCURATE).
She was ___ (ABLE) to attend because of illness.
gaps.explanation: 'Unable to attend' — negative of able is unable.

gaps.sentence: The vaccine gives ___ (PROTECT) against three strains.
gaps.explanation: 'Gives protection against' — the noun is required.

gaps.sentence: The closure of the mine will leave four hundred workers ___ (EMPLOY).
gaps.explanation: 'Leave somebody unemployed' — the negative adjective describes the workers.
